profile.name: Chiara Padovani
profile.bio: Tenant advocate and founding member of the York South—Weston Tenant Union; runner-up in Ward 5 in the 2022 municipal election (lost to Nunziata by 94 votes); endorsed in 2026 by the Toronto & York Region Labour Council and Progress Toronto.

promises.text: Fully fund, implement and enforce Vision Zero; lower speeds through road redesign; build raised intersections at the most dangerous intersections.
Close the Humber River Trail gap.
Deliver faster, more reliable snow removal.
Fight for more affordable, accessible, culturally appropriate child-care spaces.
Increase long-term investment in youth-led and community youth programs and after-school recreation.
Strengthen and expand the City Fair Wage policy to a $20 minimum wage and 10 paid sick days for City and City-contracted workers.
Create youth jobs through community benefits agreements.
Expand the non-police Community Crisis Support Service for mental-health crises, wellness checks, homelessness and evictions.
Fully and sustainably fund violence-prevention programs (Community Healing Project, Restorative Justice, Integrated Supports for Justice-Involved Youth).
Expand the hospital-based BRAVE violence-intervention program city-wide.
Increase Toronto Police Service Board transparency and accountability.
Fully fund a Gender Equity Strategy.

expensesDetailSource.name: Council Expense Routine Disclosure — Constituency Services & Office Expenses
expensesDetailSource.publisher: City Clerk's Office, City of Toronto
expensesDetailSource.note: Figures are the City's routine disclosure of constituency services and office expenses, shown as published, by category, from 2013. This is a separate publication from the annual remuneration reports in expenses.json, with a narrower scope — office spending only, not pay, benefits or staff salaries — and the two are never added together. Amounts shown as personal funds are the member's own money, as the City reports it. Invoice-level documents stay on the City's site; category amounts link to them.
